This is a guide to using redirects, of sorts.  This guide is very badly written for the present time.
==How to make your redirects with our new namespaces==

Use <nowiki>[[CV:Article Name]]</nowiki> to redirect to the '''C'''urrent '''V'''ersion of the article.<br />
Use <nowiki>[[23a:Article Name]]</nowiki> to redirect to the 2D game version ('''23a''') of the article.<br />
Use <nowiki>[[40d:Article Name]]</nowiki> to redirect to the 3D game version ('''40d''') of the article.<br />

For versioned articles, stick {{tl|av}} at the top of the page and it will insert automatic links to the other article versions present.
